splits.name: Full Body 3-Day
splits.description: Every session hits squat, hinge, push and pull — the highest-frequency start.
splits.progression: Add a small load each session while all reps stay crisp.

splits.name: Full Body 2-Day (Minimalist)
splits.description: Two hard full-body sessions a week — enough to build, easy to actually keep.
splits.progression: Add reps until the top of the range, then add load and reset reps.

splits.name: StrongLifts 5×5
splits.description: Two alternating barbell workouts, five sets of five, add weight every session.
splits.progression: Linear: +2.5 kg per session, deload 10% after three stalls.

splits.name: Starting Strength
splits.description: Rippetoe's barbell novice LP — squat every session, three lifts, 3×5.
splits.progression: Linear: add weight every workout; squat 3×5, deadlift 1×5.

splits.name: GreySkull LP
splits.description: Novice LP with an AMRAP last set and more upper-body volume than the classics.
splits.progression: Last set AMRAP: 5+ reps → add load; miss twice → reset 10%.

splits.name: r/Fitness Basic Beginner
splits.description: Reddit's default starter: two alternating full-body days, 3×5 plus an AMRAP.
splits.progression: Add load whenever the AMRAP set clears the target reps.

splits.name: Upper / Lower 4-Day
splits.description: The intermediate workhorse: every muscle twice a week, easy to balance.
splits.progression: Double progression: add reps to the top of the range, then load.

splits.name: PHUL — Power Hypertrophy Upper Lower
splits.description: Two heavy power days plus two volume days — strength and size in one week.
splits.progression: Power days 3–5 reps and add load weekly; hypertrophy days 8–12 reps.

splits.name: Push / Pull / Legs 3-Day
splits.description: One push, one pull, one leg day — the gentlest way into body-part training.
splits.progression: Double progression per exercise; one hard set added every few weeks.

splits.name: Push / Pull / Legs 5-Day Rotation
splits.description: PPL on a rolling five-day week — high frequency without a six-day commitment.
splits.progression: Rotate the cycle forward each week; add load when all sets hit the top rep.

splits.name: Reddit PPL (Metallicadpa) 6-Day
splits.description: Push/pull/legs twice over, each day anchored by a heavy barbell lift.
splits.progression: Anchor lift 5×5 into an AMRAP; +2.5 kg when the AMRAP clears.

splits.name: PHAT — Power Hypertrophy Adaptive Training
splits.description: Layne Norton's powerbuilding week: two power days plus three volume days.
splits.progression: Power days 3–5 reps; hypertrophy days start with speed work then 8–15 reps.

splits.name: Bro Split (5-Day Body Part)
splits.description: One muscle per day, big per-session volume — chest, back, shoulders, arms, legs.
splits.progression: Add a set or reps weekly; each muscle gets one very thorough session.

splits.name: Arnold Split
splits.description: Golden-era antagonist pairings twice a week — chest/back, shoulders/arms, legs.
splits.progression: Very high volume; superset the antagonist pairs and progress reps first.

splits.name: nSuns 5/3/1 LP
splits.description: A nine-set T1 wave plus a secondary lift each day — 5/3/1 with weekly jumps.
splits.progression: Weekly: the 1+ AMRAP set decides the next training-max bump.

splits.name: 5/3/1 Boring But Big
splits.description: Wendler's slow cooker: one main lift per day at 5/3/1, then 5×10 supplemental.
splits.progression: Monthly cycles off a training max; +2.5 kg upper / +5 kg lower per cycle.

splits.name: GZCLP
splits.description: Tiered T1/T2/T3 days that handle their own stalls — LP that refuses to die.

splits.name: Texas Method
splits.description: Volume Monday, light Wednesday, a new 5RM Friday — weekly, not daily, progress.
splits.progression: Weekly: 5×5 @ 90% volume day feeds a new 5RM on intensity day.

splits.name: Madcow 5×5
splits.description: The intermediate 5×5: ramped sets, heavy/light/PR week, +2.5% every Friday.
splits.progression: Weekly +2.5% on the PR-day top set; ramp the working sets underneath.

splits.name: Upper / Lower + PPL Hybrid
splits.description: Upper, lower, then push/pull/legs — the best-of-both five-day week.
splits.progression: Heavier compounds on the upper/lower days, higher reps on the PPL days.

splits.name: Push / Pull 4-Day
splits.description: Two push days, two pull days, legs folded in — simple, symmetrical, sturdy.
splits.progression: Double progression; alternate a heavy and a lighter week per movement.

splits.name: Dumbbell-Only Home 3-Day
splits.description: Every pattern covered with one pair of dumbbells and a bench — no barbell needed.
splits.progression: Reps first (8 → 15), then the next dumbbell up; slow tempo when load caps out.

splits.name: Bodyweight Recommended Routine
splits.description: Calisthenics progressions three times a week — leverage replaces load.
splits.progression: Move to the next progression once you own 3×8 with clean form.

splits.name: Kettlebell Minimalist
splits.description: Swings, get-ups and presses — 20–30 minute sessions with one implement.
splits.progression: Compress rest first, then move up a bell size.

splits.name: Athletic Conditioning Hybrid
splits.description: Two full-body power days plus two engine days — strength kept, cardio built.
splits.progression: Lift days move load; conditioning days move work density.

splits.name: Glute-Focused Strength (Strong Curves style)
splits.description: Hip-thrust-anchored days with full-body support — lower-body emphasis throughout.
splits.progression: Thrust and hinge lead the session; add load there before anything else.

splits.name: Hybrid Athlete · Lift + Run
splits.description: Two strength days, two runs and a power day — muscle kept, engine built.
splits.progression: Lift days move load; run days move easy volume first, pace second.

splits.name: Hyrox Race Prep
splits.description: Station strength, erg engine, easy runs and a brick day — built for the race format.
splits.progression: Compress station rest and hold run pace as fatigue climbs — race fitness is pace under fatigue.

splits.name: HIT · Heavy Duty (Mentzer style)
splits.description: Three short sessions, one all-out working set per exercise, days of recovery between.
splits.progression: One hard set to clean failure per movement; add load only when the top of the rep range is owned.

days.label: Chest & Back · one hard set each
Shoulders & Arms · one hard set each

splits.name: 5/3/1 for Beginners
splits.description: Two main lifts per day on 5/3/1 waves plus balanced assistance — the r/Fitness wiki flagship.
splits.progression: 5/3/1 percentage waves + First Set Last 5×5; small TM bumps each 3-week cycle.

splits.name: High-Frequency Full Body
splits.description: Five full-body days, each with a different emphasis — the science-based answer to PPL.
splits.progression: Rotate emphasis so no lift repeats on consecutive days; add reps then load per slot.
